recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1990s-style album cover featuring a group of five young performers in urban fashion, framed within a rounded rectangular window against a black, distressed background, topped with bold, oversized slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary text dominates the top third of the composition
Rounded rectangular frame creates a 'window' effect for the photography
High-contrast color palette of red, yellow, and black creates visual urgency
Distressed texture overlays the entire composition to simulate aged print
coreInvariants: Black border with simulated paper wear/scratches

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group is centered in the lower two-thirds, scaled to show waist-up figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red display text at the top acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red text, move down to the central group, and finally to the vertical yellow text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black borders provide heavy framing and separation between elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black serves as the grounding background and frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red is used for the primary display title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow is used for the vertical secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries against a low-value black background for maximum impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation for the secondary word
Slightly compressed width for the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family pairing with color and orientation contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast slab serif look with blocky terminals.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photo of five young adults in 90s urban fashion (leather jackets, patterned vests, hats) standing in front of a brick wall and window. Place this photo inside a rounded rectangular frame centered on a black background. Apply a heavy distressed paper texture with white scratches and dust across the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red slab-serif title in all caps at the top. Add a smaller yellow slab-serif word rotated 90 degrees vertically on the far left of the title area.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text a heavy slab serif?
Is the photo contained within a rounded rectangle?
Is there a visible distressed/scratched texture?
Are the colors red, yellow, and black dominant?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the photo
Specific shade of red and yellow
Corner radius of the photo frame
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is rotated 90 degrees.
Ensure the red text is the largest element.
Verify the rounded corners of the photo mask.
Confirm the presence of 'dust and scratches' texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Heavy Slab Serif + Rounded Photo Window + Black Frame + Primary Color Accents + Distressed Texture = 90s Pop Aesthetic
